statement: Because the T011 admitted envelope cannot link the gRPC runtime (`T030-GAP-02`, `T031-GAP-01`), the client **shall** realize the accepted generated message and method contract over the bounded, host-protected local-IPC framing bound 1:1 to the T030 generated method names; it **shall** add no admitted dependency and **shall not** claim a linked gRPC runtime. The deferred gRPC transport runtime **shall** be recorded as an explicit gap (`T032-GAP-01`).
title: T032 requirement 017
